visual.general_description: Eight-row montage of 23 lettered panels (A to W) of right-eye fundus photographs and OCT cross-sections from successive visits.
visual.detailed_description: The left column holds color fundus photographs, the centre column macular OCT scans and the right column superotemporal perifoveal OCT scans; the right-hand cell of the first row is empty. Each row is one visit: panels A and B, then C to E, F to H, I to K, L to N, O to Q, R to T and U to W. Fundus photographs show green-tinted fields with an orange-yellow spot near the centre, white arrows in panels A, C, L and O, a darker rectangular overlay with dashed lines in panel C, dark bubble-like shapes with small bright green reflections in panels I, L, O and R, and none in F or U. OCT scans show layered tissue that is lifted in a tent shape in B, lies along a bright line with small bumps in centre-column scans, and lies directly against a curved bright line in most right-column scans. There are no charts, axes or printed measurements.
